messages.content: Hi, for user ID user_001, please first check whether my investment account is active. Then estimate the trading cost for a $500.0 stock trade on my standard tier account. After that, get the latest business news, and sort these headlines in ascending order: “Global markets reach new highs,” “Major merger announced in tech sector,” and “Economic growth exceeds expectations.” Finally, create a backup of the workspace at /workspace/project_a and name it backup_2025_06.
Task aborted: No tool available to check investment account status. The get_account_balance_bank_api function only retrieves balances, not account activation status.
